question: Which of the following factors is NOT responsible for soil formation?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Cattle grazing.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** S**oil formation** is heavily dependent on the climate of a region.

__
 
• The speed of weathering of parent rock,
 
 
• and thereby the mineral composition and
 
• concentration of organic matter,
 
• topography,
 
• biotic agents
 
• temperature and precipitation.
 
 
 
• Temperature fluctuations are responsible for the faster physical weathering of rocks.
 
• **Hence Cattle grazing is not a factor in soil formation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pedogenesis **is the process of formation of soil regulated by the influence of place, environment, and history.
 
• Soil is a mixture of organic matter, minerals, gases, liquids, and organisms that support life.
 
• The **Pedosphere** is the Earth's body of soil.
